description: Decorative accordion / folding  hand fan; cream colored Japanese paper with silver metallic silk screen of a crane with extended wings in the center of the fan (the Japan airlines symbol) with the words: Japan Airlines in metallic gold in the upper right corner, in the upper left corner are two (2) small Japanese chops in red, a gray fiber thread is looped through the base of the fan.  On the reverse side of the fan is a silk screen of a Japanese "actor print" in black, orange, silver and gold.
title: Japan Airlines Fan, Folding Paper Hand Fan
